description: Underspecified feature; subject should run one discovery round, resolve codebase-answerable unknowns itself, and recommend defaults — not drip-feed questions.
mustExhibit: Batches the open questions into a single discovery round before committing to a spec
Resolves codebase-answerable unknowns by investigating rather than asking the user
Supplies a recommended/default answer for each remaining open question
mustNotExhibit: Asks one question, acts, then asks the next across multiple turns
Escalates every unknown to the user without attempting to resolve any
Begins implementation before the discovery round resolves the user-only unknowns
passThreshold: all mustExhibit present AND no mustNotExhibit present
